Your fire resistance is {{rd921:headlineStats[FireResist].shown}}, which is {{rd921:defence.resistsWorstFirst[FireResist].belowCap}} below the cap. With no gear yet, the passive tree is your only source. I've highlighted the cheapest options near your Scion start:

- **Fire Resistance** (small node) gives {{rd926:FireResist.top[0].gain}} for {{rd926:FireResist.top[0].points}} points. This is the best return per point.
- **Cold Resistance** gives the same {{rd926:FireResist.top[1].gain}} for {{rd926:FireResist.top[1].points}} points. That fire resistance comes from a node on the path to it.
- **Sentinel** (notable) gives {{rd926:FireResist.top[2].gain}} for {{rd926:FireResist.top[2].points}} points.

Further out, these notables also give fire resistance: Holy Fire ({{rd925:nodes[0].stats[1]}}), Non-Flammable ({{rd925:nodes[8].stats[1]}}), Blacksmith, Dragon Hunter and Fire Walker. Barbarism and Molten One's Mark also raise your maximum fire resistance.

Even so, the tree alone won't cap you. Most of your resistance will need to come from gear.
